displayCode: There is a problem with stabilizer
title: Image stabilizer communication fault
fullDescription: LUMIX G, GH, S series show 'There is a problem with stabilizer' when Dual I.S. cannot establish lens/body communication. Caused by dirty contacts, mismatched Dual I.S. firmware, or third-party Sigma MC-21 adapter issues on L-mount.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts and reseat
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe lens and body contacts; reattach lens.

fixSteps.title: Update lens firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Use Panasonic LUMIX Sync or load .bin via SD card.

whenToCallPro: If firmware update does not clear the error.

faq.a: No, but IS will be off until cleared.

title: SD/CFexpress card read failure
shortDescription: File system or card is not cooperating.
fullDescription: Shown when the body cannot open the card. Typical on formats from PC, counterfeit cards, or cards below required V-class for 4K/6K recording.
videoSearchQuery: Panasonic Lumix card access error fix

faq.a: 4K All-I needs sustained write above V30's guarantee.

title: Body cannot detect lens
fullDescription: If 'Release w/o Lens' is OFF (default), the shutter stays locked when a lens is not seen. Clean contacts, reseat, and check 'Release w/o Lens' setting for manual lenses/adapters.

fixSteps.title: Reseat lens
fixSteps.instruction: Align red/white mark, rotate to click.

fixSteps.title: Enable Release w/o Lens
fixSteps.instruction: Menu > Custom > Release w/o Lens > ON for manual glass.

videoSearchQuery: Panasonic Lumix no lens attached fix

faq.q: Does shutter work with dumb adapter?
faq.a: Only with Release w/o Lens ON.

title: Body too hot — recording will stop
fullDescription: GH5/GH6/S5 II have aggressive thermal management. While many LUMIX bodies have unlimited record, heat can still trigger a warning. Using the optional DMW-FANG (GH6) or cooling rigs extends operation.

fixSteps.title: Use fan accessory
fixSteps.instruction: GH6 supports internal fan already; S5 II users should add external fan cage.

faq.q: Does S5 II really record unlimited?
faq.a: Yes at most modes, but 5.9K 30p can still trigger warnings in hot weather.

title: DMW-BLK22 / DMW-BLJ31 end of life
fullDescription: After heavy use, LUMIX batteries gauge full then drop suddenly. Body-verified batteries (after firmware updates) refuse third-party cells.
whenToCallPro: If genuine batteries also fail to charge — service board.

faq.a: Yes, Panasonic added authentication to recent bodies.

title: DFD contrast AF indecision (pre-PDAF bodies)
shortDescription: Focus pulses back and forth continuously.
fullDescription: Older LUMIX bodies (GH5, S1, S5) used Depth from Defocus (DFD) contrast AF, which can wobble in video. Firmware improvements and switching to the newer PDAF bodies (S5 II, G9 II) fix this fundamentally.

fixSteps.title: Adjust AF sensitivity
fixSteps.instruction: Use Custom > AF Custom Setting > slower response.

videoSearchQuery: Panasonic Lumix AF hunting DFD fix

title: Lens firmware incompatible with body
fullDescription: Common with older Lumix G Vario lenses on new bodies (G9 II, GH6) — Dual I.S. 2 and AF algorithms require updated lens firmware.

fixSteps.title: Download update
fixSteps.instruction: Panasonic support page > lens model > .bin file.

fixSteps.title: Run in-camera update
fixSteps.instruction: Copy to SD card root, Menu > Firmware Version.

faq.a: Yes, full battery mandatory during update.

title: Firmware panic
shortDescription: Body locked up and asks for power cycle.
fullDescription: Generic firmware crash. Remove battery 60s, restart. Reinstall firmware if repeats.

fixSteps.title: Format SD card
fixSteps.instruction: A corrupt card can repeatedly crash firmware.

faq.a: Yes, Menu > Setup > Reset clears menu state.

title: LUMIX Sync connection failure
shortDescription: Camera cannot pair with phone or network.
fullDescription: LUMIX Sync app may fail to pair on iOS 17+ and Android 14 due to new local-network permissions. Enable local network for the app and disable battery optimization.

fixSteps.title: Grant local network permission
fixSteps.instruction: Phone Settings > LUMIX Sync > Local Network ON.

faq.a: S5 II supports both; try 5GHz for better range.

title: SD card too slow for video mode
shortDescription: Recording dropped due to slow card.
fullDescription: LUMIX tells you when a card cannot sustain the selected video bitrate. 4K All-I and 5.9K ProRes require V60/V90 or CFexpress Type B.

fixSteps.title: Use V60/V90 card or CFexpress
fixSteps.instruction: Check compatibility list for your body.

faq.a: On GH6 5.7K ProRes HQ yes, CFexpress required.
